items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: I got a picture with Nick Ben-Oni playing in the same band.

ctx.x: I wonder if he's kin to Nick. No. Nick Ben-Oni. I don't know.
But you know Nick. Oh, very well. Played many, many times. I got a picture with Nick Ben-Oni playing in the same band. Red Nichols. Yeah, that's, that's...
Sidney Boucher. That's Look Magazine. And that's that same article. I'll give it a minute. Look. Jazz. That's that same article. Look. Jazz. 된된된
